phase_c_batches.batch: google_aiplatform (Vertex AI / Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform)
phase_c_batches.notes: Live-verified: Vertex AI was rebranded 'Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform' at Google Cloud Next 2026 -- the aiplatform.googleapis.com wire API and most cloud.google.com URLs are unchanged, but agent/session/memory/reasoning_engine/sandbox_environment/semantic_governance_policy now live under the new doc tree. Verified persistent_resource, specialist_pool, nas_job, semantic_governance_policy are all still active (not deprecated) via direct search, not assumed from training data. Two duplicate wire-type keys (google_aiplatform_online_evaluator / google_aiplatform_aiplatform_online_evaluator) both written identically -- pre-existing key-correction artifact from Phase B, out of scope to fix here. google_aiplatform_time_sery is a truncated/mis-pluralized 'TimeSeries' wire name, described accordingly.

Live-verified: Advanced API Security (security_action/security_profile/security_profiles_v2/security_monitoring_condition/security_feedback/host_security_report/security_report), Apigee Spaces (space, a genuinely recent 2025-era isolation feature), and the APIM Service Extension (apim_service_extension, a load-balancer integration) all confirmed current and active, not assumed from general Apigee knowledge. google_apigee_canaryevaluation verified real via its own REST resource (organizations.instances.canaryEvaluations) and a Google developer forum thread explaining it, despite having no dedicated overview page of its own -- an internal runtime-rollout health check, not a caller-facing deploy strategy; written from that thinner but real source, not skipped.

Live-verified: Dataplex Universal Catalog was renamed 'Knowledge Catalog' as of 2026-04-10 -- API/CLI/IAM names unchanged, described accordingly (current product name, technical API name noted). data_domain/data_product are a real, current 2025-2026-era data mesh capability (curated business-ready data packages), not assumed from older Dataplex-lake-only knowledge.

Live-verified: the intercept_*/mirroring_*/dns_threat_detector resources belong to Google Cloud's real, current Network Security Integration (NSI) framework for third-party appliance traffic inspection and DNS Armor (Infoblox partnership) threat detection -- confirmed via Google's own NSI blog announcement and Cloud NGFW intrusion-prevention docs, not assumed. sac_attachment/sac_realm confirmed as Secure Access Connect, a distinct, separately-branded SSE product with its own real REST resource (projects.locations.sacRealms) and docs tree, not part of google_networksecurity's own product despite sharing the wire-type family prefix -- described as such.

Contact Center AI Insights (Conversational Insights), a well-established, actively documented product -- QA scorecard/authorized_view/assistant_session are the newer, real 2025-2026-era additions, confirmed part of the same product family from context, no rename or deprecation found.

Live-verified: agent_gateway/agent_connectivity_template are Agent Gateway, a genuinely new (2026) Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform networking component -- confirmed via Google's own docs, would have read as fabricated from pre-2026 training knowledge. multicast_consumer_association/multicast_group_consumer_activation confirmed as Cloud Multicast, a real, current, and notably NEW VPC capability (multicast was NOT historically supported on GCP VPC) -- verified live via the actual REST method reference, not assumed. lb_edge_extension confirmed via its own real API docs. producer_extension found no dedicated overview page of its own but is a real, present resource following the same well-documented Service Extensions/PSC pattern as its sibling extension types -- written from that pattern, flagged here as thinner-than-usual sourcing rather than silently treated as equally solid.

Dialogflow CX (Conversational Agents) -- playbook/generator/example/tool are the real, GA generative-agent-building features (as distinct from the older hand-built flow/page state machine model), well documented, no rename found.
API hub, GA product, no rename found. instance/api_hub_instance are the same known key-correction-artifact duplicate pattern seen in aiplatform -- written identically.

Live-verified: multicloud_data_transfer_config confirmed real via its own actual REST endpoint (multicloudDataTransferConfigs, networkconnectivity.googleapis.com) and Data Transfer Essentials billing docs -- a genuinely recent Cross-Cloud Interconnect billing feature, not assumed.

Live-verified: Vertex AI Search / Discovery Engine is in the process of being renamed 'Agent Search' as of 2026 -- both names still circulate in Google's own docs (the API package is still google.cloud.discoveryengine.v1), noted in the intro text rather than silently written as only 'Vertex AI Search'. identity_mapping_store and license_config confirmed real, current resources via their own actual REST reference, not assumed.

Live-verified: proposal/single_tenant_hsm_instance confirmed real via Google's own generated client library samples and gcloud CLI reference -- a genuinely newer, quorum-based dedicated-HSM administration model, not assumed from standard multi-tenant Cloud HSM knowledge.
Sensitive Data Protection (formerly Cloud DLP), established GA product, no further rename found beyond the already-known DLP->Sensitive Data Protection rebrand.
